compiled_state.description:
## Testing Mode: RED

Write behavioral tests for detect-session-leakage.sh BEFORE implementation exists. All tests must FAIL when the implementation script is absent.

## Story DD Coverage
This task satisfies: DD1 (cases 1, 2), DD2 (case 3), DD3 (case 4, 4b), DD4 (case 5), DD6

## Test Setup Pattern

Each test case:
1. Creates scratch git repo via `mktemp -d`
2. Sets up shared ancestor commit, then session branch + target branches
3. Creates stub at $TMPDIR/dso for ticket CLI calls: `export DSO_TICKET_CLI="$TMPDIR/dso"`
4. Stubs returns controlled JSON for ticket lookups (open/closed story, candidate list)
5. Asserts on exit code, git log state, and stderr content

**CRITICAL**: T1 must set `export DSO_TICKET_CLI="$TMPDIR/dso"` — NOT rely on PATH prepend. The default value in T2 is a path-qualified binary (.claude/scripts/dso), so PATH prepend would not intercept it.

git log boundary: scratch repos must have a shared ancestor commit so that only commits after the divergence point are scanned. Set up: init repo, make base commit, create 'main' branch there, create session branch, inject commits on session branch only.

## Test Cases

**Case 1 (DD1 — valid DSO-Story trailer)**
- Given: scratch repo with session branch diverged from main; non-merge commit on session with `DSO-Story: Open Story Title` trailer; `story/e1/s1` branch exists; stub CLI returns open story ID s1, epic parent_id e1
- When: detect-session-leakage.sh invoked (no flags)
- Then: exits 0; commit SHA appears in `git log --oneline story/e1/s1`

**Case 2 (Orphan — DSO-Task only, no DSO-Story)**
- Given: non-merge commit on session with `DSO-Task: Some Task Title` but no DSO-Story; stub CLI not called for orphan path
- When: detect-session-leakage.sh invoked
- Then: exits 0; SHA appears in `git log story/orphan-<current-branch-name>`

**Case 3 (DD2 — no DSO trailers)**
- Given: non-merge commit with no DSO-prefixed trailers at all (may have Co-Authored-By but no DSO-*)
- When: detect-session-leakage.sh invoked
- Then: exits non-zero; stderr contains 'manual attribution' and offending SHA

**Case 4 (DD3 — closed-story DSO-Story trailer)**
- Given: non-merge commit with `DSO-Story: Closed Story Title`; stub returns closed story with ID c1 epic e1; stub also returns ≥1 open candidate story
- When: detect-session-leakage.sh invoked
- Then: exits non-zero; stderr contains '--force-route-to' and at least one candidate open story ID

**Case 4b (DD3 — --force-route-to with nonexistent branch)**
- Given: same closed-story commit from Case 4; no story/e1/open-story branch exists
- When: detect-session-leakage.sh --force-route-to=open-story invoked
- Then: exits non-zero; stderr contains branch-not-found message AND offending SHA

**Case 5 (DD4 — cherry-pick conflict)**
- Given: both session branch and target story branch have commits modifying same file in conflicting ways; non-merge commit on session with valid DSO-Story trailer
- When: detect-session-leakage.sh invoked
- Then: exits non-zero; git repo is clean (git cherry-pick --abort cleaned up); stderr contains offending SHA and ≥1 conflicting file path

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] All 6 test cases written as behavioral tests (exit codes, git log state, stderr content)
- [ ] tests/scripts/test-detect-session-leakage.sh is executable (chmod +x)
- [ ] .test-index entry added: `plugins/dso/scripts/detect-session-leakage.sh:tests/scripts/test-detect-session-leakage.sh` (no bracket notation needed — whole file is RED while script absent)
- [ ] All tests FAIL when plugins/dso/scripts/detect-session-leakage.sh does not exist
- [ ] DSO_TICKET_CLI set via `export`, not PATH prepend
- [ ] Each test uses mktemp -d isolation with cleanup trap
- [ ] Follow plugins/dso/skills/shared/prompts/behavioral-testing-standard.md

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user
